#include <stdio.h>
int x = 180;
void func() {
    static int x = 10;
    x += 5;
    printf("%d ", x);
}
int main() {
    int x = 1;
    printf("%d ", x);
    func();
    {
        int x = 50;
        x++;
        printf("%d ", x);
        func();
    }
    printf("%d", x);
    return 0;
}

What will be the output of the above program?
A 1 15 51 20 1
B 1 10 51 15 1
C 1 15 51 15 100
D 1 15 51 20 100
question.subject: Programming in C

question.text:
Consider the following recursive function definition:

function FOO(n)
    if (n=0) then
        return 0
    else if ( n = 1) then
        return 1
    else if ( n = 2) then
        return 3
    else
        return n + FOO(n-1) + FOO(n-2)
    end if
end function

What is the value returned by $F O O(5)$ ?
A. $10$
B. $14$
C. $26$
D. $35$
question.subject: Programming in C

question.text:
Consider the following C program executed on a little-endian system:

#include <stdio.h>
int main() {
    int a = 320;
    char *ptr;
    ptr = (char *)&a;
    printf("%d ", "ptr);
    return 0;
}

What will be the output of the program?
A. $2$
B. $320$
C. $64$
D. Compilation error

Consider the following C program:

#include <stdio.h>
#include <conio.h>
void main()
{
    int *ptr, i;
    i = 12;
    *ptr = i * i;
    ++i;
    printf("%d %d", i, *ptr);
}

What will be the output of the above program?

  1. $12,144$
  2. $13,144$
  3. $13,0$
  4. None of these

#include<stdio.h>
#include<conio.h>
void main()
{
int i, n=2;
    for(i=0; i<2 ; i++ )

        if(!(i<=n) && (++n==i))

What will be the output of this program?
